title: Burstwise → PTO Import
text: This tool packages legacy burst analysis folders (bi4_bur, bg4, br4, Info, .mti) into the project: each measurement's burst runs become children of its photon stream in the Datasets workspace.

title: Start with the sample folder
text: Load example points the importer at the legacy burstwise folder that ships with the plugin and scans it, so the inventory, the source resolution and the conversion below all have something to show.

title: Select analysis folder
text: The folder to import. Drop a legacy burstwise folder on the ChiSurf window: the drop hands it to this tool, which scans it.

title: Scan folder contents
text: Click Scan to discover measurement stems, companion tables, Info settings, and folder-name parameters.

title: Source resolution
text: Choose how raw TTTR files are located: by re-mapping original paths from .mti or by checking for files with matching stems beside the folder.

title: Convert to PTO
text: Click Run to convert the detected measurements into measurement containers of the project; their burst runs appear in the Datasets workspace under their photon streams.

title: Review results
text: The results pane lists written .mmfdb.pto containers and flags any columns that could not be mapped to the dictionary.
